what_h_is: handedness: for each obligated token, WHO handed the verifier its target. M2 in AUDIT_the_whole_program_2026_09_01.md: an instrument measured where the target was supplied collapses when it must find the target. The mapping below is DECLARED, not derived; a source the verifier can emit that is absent from this table fails tests/test_h_mapping.py.

handedness_classes.object_text: the target was selected by WORDS of the document under judgement, on or around the token's line. The object hands the verifier its target.
handedness_classes.object_form: the target was selected by the SHAPE of the token itself (printed precision), not by any surrounding vocabulary. Still the object, not its words.
handedness_classes.receipt: the target was selected from the RECEIPT side (the evidence names what must be checked). No obligation source of this verifier does this.
handedness_classes.external: the target was declared by a party other than the object's text and the receipt: a preregistration, a panel, or the author binding a span at write time (sworn/0.1). No obligation source of this verifier does this.

vocabulary.clause: _TRIGGERS matches the token's binding context (bctx); the oldest clause (v0)
vocabulary.note: the brief's object_text. Its share of VERIFIED tokens (0.35, LIVE) is the handedness figure the epistemics summary already computes per certificate.
vocabulary.grain_note: header-bound bctx is structural, a line word is incidental; v3 split this source into the 0.9515 and 0.6391 cells.

n-glued.clause: `n=` glued directly before the token (V05_SELF_SCOPED_N, PREREG_oath_v05_precision)
n-glued.note: self-scoped since v0.5: the `n=` register obligates only its own glued token.
n-glued.grain_note: the `n=` register is the author's own notation glued to the token; it cannot co-occur by accident.

range-correlation.clause: _TRIGGERS_CORR on bctx AND decimals > 0 AND value in [-1, 1] (v0.4, PREREG_oath_v04_recall_decimalguard)
range-correlation.note: a conjunction of vocabulary (necessary) and form (a guard). Classed by the necessary conjunct: without the correlation word nothing fires.
range-correlation.grain_note: a correlation word somewhere in the bctx plus a value in [-1, 1]; nothing the author committed to names this token.

precision.clause: the token prints >= V07_PRECISION_DIGITS (7) fractional digits (V07_PRECISION_OBLIGATION)
precision.note: the only shipped source that reads no vocabulary. precision_only obligations are ULP-escapable.

range-sanity.clause: bounded-quantity vocabulary directly before the token AND the value leaves its possible range (v0.3); recorded as the source only when no earlier clause obligated the token (first-writer, fixed 2026-08-30)
range-sanity.note: emittable, zero in both populations on 2026-09-01: every out-of-range token so far was already obligated by vocabulary.
range-sanity.grain_note: a bounded word before a number is a coin abroad: 13 external accusations, 0 genuine, 0 of the lab's own tokens moved (RESULT_range_sanity_report_SHIP_2026_09_02). Reports instead of accusing under V14_RANGE_SANITY_REPORT.

structural-precision.clause: OBLIGATE-1: >= 2 fractional digits AND outside a code span (PREREG_obligate1_2026_08_31)
structural-precision.note: DEFINED, NOT SHIPPED: RESULT_obligate1_does_not_ship_2026_08_31. Declared here so the sixth source the lane has named is in the same table as the five it emits, and so that shipping it later is a one-flag change to this file rather than a silent new partition of the corpus.

instrument_level.what: a classification PER INSTRUMENT of where its targets come from. It is a different population from the token histogram above: an instrument is one row whatever its token count, and a hypothesis about instruments (handed-target instruments collapse held-out; found-target ones do not) is tested on THIS table, never on token shares.

styxx.certify obligation predicate.target_grain_note: header-bound and n-glued obligations are structural; line-word, correlation-word and range-sanity obligations are incidental. Its held-out figure pools both; v3 unpooled them.

styxx.diffgate path-claim accuser.measured_held_out: 0.16 precision against a 0.95 floor (RESULT_v14_naming_the_defects_did_not_save_it_2026_09_01); accusing branch deleted
styxx.diffgate path-claim accuser.target_grain_note: a path-shaped string co-occurring in prose; no author commitment names it as a claim.

styxx.claimdetect STRUCT-1.target_grain_note: its structure is sentence shape the detector infers (verb stems, path tokens), not a label the author committed to.

styxx.sworn (sworn/0.1).measured_held_out: NONE — unmeasured by design of the spec; the author binds the target at write time
styxx.sworn (sworn/0.1).target_grain_note: the limiting case: the author's tag is the whole target and nothing co-occurs.

instrument_level.do_not_conflate: token-level h is a share over tokens inside one instrument; instrument-level h is a label over instruments. Drawing the test of an instrument-level hypothesis from the token histogram measures the wrong population — the one the certificates print rather than the one the hypothesis is about.
instrument_level.target_grain: a column over instruments, 2026-09-02: does the instrument take its targets from labels the author committed to (structural) or from co-occurrence it inferred (incidental)? An instrument can do both. Same population as the rows: one label per instrument, never a token share.

object_text_grain.what: object_text splits by HOW the object's words handed the target. Named on 2026-09-02 after RESULT_handedness_v3_header_handed_2026_09_02 (header-handed accusations genuine at 0.9515, line-handed at 0.6391, same panel) and read across the day's verdicts in SYNTHESIS_the_grain_of_the_handed_target_2026_09_02.md. DECLARED, not derived; the classes above stay as declared.
object_text_grain.structural: the target was handed by a label the author chose and committed to: a column header bound to the token, a register glued to it by the author's own notation. Cannot arise by accident of proximity.
object_text_grain.incidental: the target was handed by a word that co-occurred on the line, or by a rule written for one idiom firing in another. Proximity, not commitment.
object_text_grain.mixed: the source hands both kinds and the certificate can tell them apart per token: epistemics.binding_context.header_bound true is structural, false is incidental (the v3 join rule).
object_text_grain.object_form_has_no_grain: precision and structural-precision read the token's shape, never the object's words; grain is null for them.
